title: Primer · Series: geometric and Taylor
about: Ten slides: what an endless sum is worth, the geometric sum in one line, Taylor polynomials, where the ln(1+x) series fails, computing e^x and Bessel's I_0 term by term; after each, a proof slide (the halves reach 2, the geometric sum, the Taylor coefficients, the ln(1+x) error bound, the term recipe).
